question: Which city hosted the 28th All India Forest Sports Meet 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dehradun**__.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **28th All India Forest Sports Meet (AIFSM)** was scheduled to be hosted in **Dehradun**, the capital city of **Uttarakhand**, in **2025**.
 
• This prestigious national event is organized to encourage **physical fitness**, **sportsmanship**, and **professional camaraderie** among the personnel of the **Forest Departments** across all **Indian States** and **Union Territories**.
 
• **Dehradun** is historically significant as the **Forest Capital of India**, housing top-tier institutions that provide the necessary infrastructure for large-scale athletic competitions involving over **2,500 participants**.
 
• The meet features approximately **23 to 25 sporting disciplines**, including **track and field**, **archery**, **rifle shooting**, **badminton**, and **swimming**, specifically designed to test the endurance of forest staff.
 
• The selection of **Dehradun** follows the successful completion of the **27th edition** held in **Raipur**, **Chhattisgarh**, maintaining the tradition of rotating the host state to promote **regional sports tourism** and **infrastructure development**.

 **Additional Information__**

 
• **All India Forest Sports Meet (AIFSM)**:
 
 
• The initiative was launched by the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)** in **1993**, with the inaugural event held in **Hyderabad**.
 
• It aims to provide a much-needed break and recreational outlet for **field staff** like **Range Officers** and **Guardians** who work in high-stress **wildlife conservation** zones.
 
 
 
• **Forest Research Institute (FRI)**:
 
 
• Located in **Dehradun**, **FRI** is a premier **forestry research institution** in **India**, established in **1906**.
 
• The campus is a major **tourist attraction** known for its **Greco-Roman architecture** and its role as the nodal center for the **Indian Council of Forestry Research and Education (ICFRE)**.
 
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi National Forest Academy (IGNFA)**:
 
 
• Also situated in **Dehradun**, it is the primary **training institute** for officers of the **Indian Forest Service (IFS)**.
